name: Beretta Breva EX
notes: Haier YRW02 protocol (14-byte A6 frame, IRremoteESP8266 HaierAC YRW02 layout). Full-state frames: every code carries mode, setpoint, fan and both louvre axes; clock zeroed, button byte POWER, power bit absolute. Timings and louvre positions captured from the original remote (Flipper Zero + BroadSniff); codes generated from that decode. Swing combines vertical and horizontal positions because HAIR has one swing axis. Verified on two units (office, bedroom) with Broadlink RM4C mini: modes, setpoints, vertical and horizontal louvres.
